Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.

Illustrative what-if bounds. A hold sweep of 15 minutes to 24 hours brackets the 2-hour baseline for the demo brief's longer-hold question; five values keep a 1,000-employee sweep within a presenter preparation slot. Points range from no allowance to three times the canonical allowance. Each experiment changes one key only, so the source of a difference is clear.
